Page 54 of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000): behind-the-scenes stills of Shannon Baksa becoming Mara Jade, the printed [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] card, and Scott Chernoff's Timothy Zahn sidebar. Chernoff writes that the green outfit "will be issued later as another Power Card in the game."

Fair use of one magazine page for encyclopedia commentary on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]. Source: Internet Archive item [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials] (issue 047 scan).
